run_conformance_test: run the protobuf conformance test driver that reads requests from stdin and writes responses to stdout
test_do_test: test the do_test function by passing a ConformanceRequest and verifying the ConformanceResponse payload
test_do_test_io: test the do_test_io function that reads length-prefixed protobuf messages from stdin and writes responses
review_protocol_error: review the ProtocolError custom exception class used for invalid protobuf conformance requests
summarize_conformance_driver: summarize the conformance test driver main loop that processes tests until EOF from stdin
